summary: DevvStream Corp. filed an 8-K reporting a private placement of 250,025 pre-funded warrants to Helena Partners Inc. for $250,000 ($0.9999 per warrant). The warrants are immediately exercisable at $0.0001 per share with a 4.99% beneficial ownership limitation (up to 9.99% at investor election). Proceeds are for working capital. This is a routine capital-raising transaction, not a special situation, as it does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. The filing was made under Items 1.01 and 3.02 for a material definitive agreement and unregistered equity sale.
